```{r pkgs, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(IPDfromKM)
library(survival)
library(KMtoIPD)
library(tidyverse); theme_set(theme_bw())
```

```{r seed}
set.seed(427)
```

```{r}
n     <- 200
gamma <- 1.2
lambda <- 0.08

t_event <- rweibull(n, shape = gamma, scale = 1/lambda)
c_max   <- 15
t_cens  <- runif(n, 0, c_max)

time   <- pmin(t_event, t_cens)
status <- as.integer(t_event <= t_cens)

fit_true <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1)
```


```{r}
png("km_sim.png", width = 800, height = 600, res = 150)
plot(
  fit_true,
  main      = "Simulated KM (with censoring)",
  xlab      = "Time",
  ylab      = "Survival",
  mark.time = TRUE,
  mark      = 3  
)
dev.off()
```


```{r}
library(png)

img <- readPNG("km_sim.png") 
class(img)

windows()
df_raw <- getpoints(
  img,
  x1 = 0,
  x2 = 15, 
  y1 = 0,  
  y2 = 1   
)

df2   <- df_raw[order(df_raw$x), ]
t_all <- df2$x
S_all <- df2$y   

```


```{r}
n_cens <- sum(status == 0) 
pts <- locator(n = n_cens)
cens_times_digitized <- pts$x

ipd_kmto <- KMtoIPD::getIPD(
  n      = n0,
  t      = t_all,
  S      = S_all,
  cens.t = cens_times
)

head(ipd_kmto)
```

```{r}
fit_kmto <- survfit(Surv(t, event) ~ 1, data = ipd_kmto)

plot(
  fit_true,
  col       = "black",
  lwd       = 2,
  main      = "Original vs KMtoIPD reconstructed",
  mark.time = TRUE,  
  mark      = 3, 
  cex       = 1.1
)

lines(
  fit_kmto,
  col       = "red",
  lty       = 2,
  mark.time = TRUE, 
  mark      = 3,   
  mark.col  = "red",
  cex       = 1.1
)

legend("topright",
       c("True", "KMtoIPD"),
       col = c("black", "red"),
       lwd = 2, lty = c(1, 2))

```

```{r}
dat <- data.frame(
  time = t_drop,
  surv = S_drop * 100  
)
```

```{r}
trisk <- seq(0, 15, by = 3) 
nrisk <- sapply(trisk, function(t0) sum(time >= t0))

cbind(trisk, nrisk)
```

```{r}
pre_ipd <- IPDfromKM::preprocess(
  dat   = dat,
  trisk = trisk,
  nrisk = nrisk,
  maxy  = 100
)

est_ipd <- IPDfromKM::getIPD(
  prep   = pre_ipd,
  armID  = 1,
  tot.events = sum(status == 1)  
)

ipd_ipdfkm <- est_ipd$IPD

head(ipd_ipdfkm)
```

```{r}
fit_ipdfkm <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ 1, data = ipd_ipdfkm)

plot(
  fit_true,
  col       = "black",
  lwd       = 2,
  main      = "True vs KMtoIPD vs IPDfromKM",
  mark.time = TRUE,  
  mark      = 3,     
)

lines(
  fit_kmto,
  col       = "red",
  lty       = 2,
  mark.time = TRUE, 
  mark      = 3,  
  mark.col  = "red"
)

lines(
  fit_ipdfkm,
  col       = "blue",
  lty       = 3,
  mark.time = TRUE,
  mark      = 3,
  mark.col  = "blue"
)

legend("topright",
       c("True", "KMtoIPD", "IPDfromKM"),
       col = c("black","red","blue"),
       lwd = 2, lty = c(1,2,3))
```


```{r}
grid_t <- seq(0, max(time), length.out = 200)

S_true   <- summary(fit_true,   times = grid_t)$surv
S_kmto   <- summary(fit_kmto,   times = grid_t)$surv
S_ipdfkm <- summary(fit_ipdfkm, times = grid_t)$surv

rmse <- function(x, y) sqrt(mean((x - y)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

rmse_kmto   <- rmse(S_true, S_kmto)
rmse_ipdfkm <- rmse(S_true, S_ipdfkm)

rmse_kmto
rmse_ipdfkm
```
